claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lamp as easy to use, with automatic motion-sensor activation and multiple timer settings.
Many customers describe the lamp as lightweight and compact while still delivering salon-quality results.
Several reviewers highlight fast curing and the built-in fan that reduces the burning sensation and disperses warm air.
A few negative reviews cite poor plastic quality for the price and a damaged item with unhelpful customer service.
Some reviewers note that nails remain tacky until the top coat is cured and wiped with alcohol.
